EPOCHS = 1
LR = 0.001
AUGMENTATION = {"time_shift": False, "noise_injection": False, "mixup": 0.2, "specaugment": False}

class SE(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, channels):
        super().__init__()
        self.avg_pool = nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))
        self.fc = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(channels, 1, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid()
        )
    def forward(self, x):
        b, c, h, w = x.shape
        y = self.avg_pool(x).view(b, c, 1, 1)
        y = self.fc(y).view(b, 1, 1, 1)
        return x * y

class MyModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, num_classes):
        super().__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(1, 32, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(32)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.dropout1 = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(64)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.dropout2 = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(64, num_classes, 3, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(num_classes)
        self.relu3 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.dropout3 = nn.Dropout(0.1)

        self.se = SE(num_classes)
        self.head = nn.Linear(num_classes, 128)

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.dropout1(x)

        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.bn2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.dropout2(x)

        x = self.conv3(x)
        x = self.bn3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)
        x = self.dropout3(x)

        x = self.se(x)
        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
        logits = self.head(x)
        return logits
